problem: Structural validation was easy to mistake for full evidence coverage. The inventory omitted some unnumbered PRD prose and could not show control reachability.
documented_resolution: Distinguish candidate inventory, reviewed requirements and runtime evidence. Keep unlinked statements and controls visible as blockers to source-complete sign-off.
verification: Corrupt one source byte and remove one capability row in a working copy; verify both mutations are detected independently.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Distinguish candidate inventory, reviewed requirements and runtime evidence. Keep unlinked statements and controls visible as blockers to source-complete sign-off.

problem: The explicitly approved unified console decision was submerged in proposed wording; source waves were easily mistaken for release commitments.
documented_resolution: Preserve approved OD-01 and ADR-020. Record four personas and provider/reseller/agency as established direction. Keep feature releases and dependency approval open.
verification: Evaluate a release plan with one source-listed capability and no scope approval; expect no enablement.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: P1 OD-01 and ADR-020 explicitly approve a unified administration console. Scope and rollout remain open.

problem: Desired state commits alone do not establish host effect atomicity. PRD architecture direction was flattened into an entirely new proposal.
documented_resolution: Retain inherited stack direction as source evidence subject to DEC-001 and DEC-002 implementation decisions. Model control-plane commit, host journal, observed effect and terminal result as distinct boundaries.
verification: Inject a crash after intent commit and again after effect before receipt; verify one logical operation, one observable effect and terminal state only after observation.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Retain inherited stack direction as source evidence subject to DEC-001 and DEC-002 implementation decisions. Model control-plane commit, host journal, observed effect and terminal result as distinct boundaries.

problem: A stale update test did not cover ownership changing in parallel. Illustrative source SQL did not enforce all tenancy invariants.
documented_resolution: Bind writes, references and delayed effects to authoritative owner revision. A cross-tenant relationship or stale revision causes transactional rejection. Schema engine and constraints remain open.
verification: Race reassignment against a write at old revision and validate values, generation and ownership edges after both transactions.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Bind writes, references and delayed effects to authoritative owner revision. A cross-tenant relationship or stale revision causes transactional rejection. Schema engine and constraints remain open.

problem: Host-root limits and compromised-daemon boundary were underrepresented; early tests did not cover CSRF or an untrusted local caller.
documented_resolution: Preserve P1 INV-05 and §35.3: OS root has technical access, and a compromised daemon may exercise the helper's full per-peer allowlist. Browser confirmation does not constrain it.
verification: Attempt forbidden host operations as a hostile API principal and as the helper's authorized daemon peer; independently assert the root-owned host allowlist.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: P1 INV-05 and §35.3 distinguish host root and compromised daemon from application-role guarantees.

problem: The original test combined restart and DNS failures without isolating claim replay and installed-to-unclaimed transitions.
documented_resolution: Link loopback bootstrap to P1 ADR-004 as source direction. Port exposure, token delivery, TTL and console recovery remain open. Challenge consumption, owner creation and progress need a single atomic checkpoint.
verification: Freeze time just before and at claim expiry, then race two valid clients and reboot between claim and enrollment.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Link loopback bootstrap to P1 ADR-004 as source direction. Port exposure, token delivery, TTL and console recovery remain open. Challenge consumption, owner creation and progress need a single atomic checkpoint.

problem: The helper could be read as independently verifying human membership. The PRD separates peer enforcement and application authorization.
documented_resolution: API/worker owns human authorization. Helper independently enforces peer identity, root-owned target scope, action allowlist and fencing. For an ambiguous action without observable postcondition, block automated retry and surface operator recovery.
verification: Send same operation ID with changed payload and replay original after lost ack; compare journal, host generation and effect counter.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: P1 §35–36 assigns human authorization to control plane, independent OS target and peer policy to helper. Wire protocol awaits DEC-003.

problem: Ubuntu/Debian were named without an approved exact support matrix and OS rollback was conflated with application rollback.
documented_resolution: Support entries need install, upgrade, reboot, recovery and independently verified management access results for exact tuples. Document explicit package rollback versus snapshot/restore constraints.
verification: Run preflight against unsupported tuple and forced package lock as separate cases; verify no package DB change.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Support entries need install, upgrade, reboot, recovery and independently verified management access results for exact tuples. Document explicit package rollback versus snapshot/restore constraints.

problem: A pre-existing authenticated connection could be mistaken for successful post-change management reachability.
documented_resolution: Require a fresh independent connection. Protect parser semantics and timer state from daemon/UI disconnect. Capture IPv4/IPv6 and rollback outcome for applicable tuples.
verification: Break access in an isolated network fixture while holding an old authenticated socket, terminate UI and daemon, and observe watchdog restoration.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Require a fresh independent connection. Protect parser semantics and timer state from daemon/UI disconnect. Capture IPv4/IPv6 and rollback outcome for applicable tuples.

problem: Renewal and hostname verification were not cleanly separated from DNS proof, route activation, and certificate expiry.
documented_resolution: Model separate domain proof, route verification, and certificate validity states. An expired certificate can still be present but cannot be presented as healthy or trusted. Supported validation challenge and outage policy are open.
verification: Inject wrong SAN, expired certificate and failed reload one at a time. Observe served certificate and health from independent HTTPS probe.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Model separate domain proof, route verification, and certificate validity states. An expired certificate can still be present but cannot be presented as healthy or trusted. Supported validation challenge and outage policy are open.

problem: The catalog conflated optional runtime profiles with commitments, and insufficiently covered reused PID and alias bypass.
documented_resolution: Pin supervisor and workload identity, verify before signals, protect canonical unit and aliases, keep terminal and OCI candidates gated.
verification: Reuse a PID or unit alias to target protected process and confirm no signal reaches that process.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Pin supervisor and workload identity, verify before signals, protect canonical unit and aliases, keep terminal and OCI candidates gated.

problem: Data-safe compensation did not fully define concurrent ownership transfer or distinguish application code ownership from site file access.
documented_resolution: Resolve ownership and grants before each effect; stale transfers and independent writers are denied or fenced. P4 site/deployment target linkage requires explicit consent and ownership review.
verification: Inject a second writer into the active web root while deploy is prepared; transfer ownership and verify old pending effects cannot commit.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Resolve ownership and grants before each effect; stale transfers and independent writers are denied or fenced. P4 site/deployment target linkage requires explicit consent and ownership review.

problem: DB metadata visibility, data-plane isolation, archive safety and credential lifecycle were compressed into one check.
documented_resolution: Separate CRUD permission from DB grant and rotation. Respect data-engine limits. Hard links, symlinks and mount identity are separate threat scenarios; destructive DB drops need review/retention rules.
verification: Attempt a hard-link archive escape, symlink exchange and cross-database read independently; verify protected file fingerprints and database audit.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Separate CRUD permission from DB grant and rotation. Respect data-engine limits. Hard links, symlinks and mount identity are separate threat scenarios; destructive DB drops need review/retention rules.

problem: A checksum verification could be confused with successful application-level restoration; recoverability of independent keys was missing from test evidence.
documented_resolution: Require workload-level integrity, observed recovery interval, isolated key recovery and explicit approval for cutover. Keep remote retention and recovery targets unresolved.
verification: Restore known backup with unavailable key and again with known-good key without access to original host.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Require workload-level integrity, observed recovery interval, isolated key recovery and explicit approval for cutover. Keep remote retention and recovery targets unresolved.

problem: A failed deployment rollback could imply mutating immutable releases or undoing incompatible database migrations automatically.
documented_resolution: Preserve historic release/artifact IDs. Rollback is a new deployment to a prior digest after compatibility checks. Require target consent and invalidate approval on digest, configuration or target changes.
verification: Use valid approval on original tuple then substitute target, digest and configuration independently; zero new accepted jobs for altered tuples.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Preserve historic release/artifact IDs. Rollback is a new deployment to a prior digest after compatibility checks. Require target consent and invalidate approval on digest, configuration or target changes.

problem: Delivery was treated as observable across all mail providers. Optional mailbox hosting and transactional SMTP are different scopes.
documented_resolution: SMTP acceptance is observable. Delivery requires trusted separate evidence, and otherwise remains unknown. Deduplicate provider webhooks and avoid retrying ambiguous sends without provider-supported reconciliation.
verification: Simulate timeout after provider acceptance with and without a provider event. Verify no unwarranted delivered status or duplicate send.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Recovery SMTP and optional mailbox scope remain separate. Unknown delivery is not verifiable delivery. DEC-007 remains open.

problem: MFA preservation was clear, but challenge scope, concurrent redemption, logout and already-issued proof revocation were under-specified.
documented_resolution: Bind challenge to principal, credential/session context and purpose. Separate recovery-code enrollment, reset and full session issuance. Server recovery design stays open and cannot imply an MFA bypass.
verification: Race reset and MFA recovery-code redemption separately; assert single consumption and denied access from pre-reset sessions.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Bind challenge to principal, credential/session context and purpose. Separate recovery-code enrollment, reset and full session issuance. Server recovery design stays open and cannot imply an MFA bypass.

problem: Four view personas and raw G/O/W/P/C could be misused as role grants. Revocation tests lacked delayed operations and artifact access.
documented_resolution: Preserve source role names, scope and explicit verb boundaries. Add independent checks at request, dispatch, event delivery and artifact retrieval. Retain deployment approval and last-owner protection as policy decisions if unresolved.
verification: Use no-role, delegated, unrelated tenant, revoked, expired support and rightful actors against a seeded object and its derived artifacts.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Preserve source role names, scope and explicit verb boundaries. Add independent checks at request, dispatch, event delivery and artifact retrieval. Retain deployment approval and last-owner protection as policy decisions if unresolved.

problem: Control candidates were blanket-assigned and keyboard tests did not name fixture/state, browser or route.
documented_resolution: Treat preview-only and theme controls separately from product actions. Identify related scripts and visible routes; runtime state discovery is still required before completeness sign-off.
verification: Load each of the four home routes; traverse settings and switch scope with delayed response, focus restoration and revocation.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Treat preview-only and theme controls separately from product actions. Identify related scripts and visible routes; runtime state discovery is still required before completeness sign-off.

problem: Planning allocations were confused with enforced quotas, and optional billing assumptions could affect core account flows.
documented_resolution: Use distinct planned/reserved/measured/enforced fields per P2 H-008. Enforcement depends on the provisioner and committed slice. Billing/payment/white-label/support scope stays individually gated.
verification: Seed an allocation without a provisioner and verify it displays planning status; then race enforced allocations on a fixture with provisioner.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: P2 H-008 distinguishes planned, reserved, measured and enforced. Scope and policy remain open.

problem: Unknown/stale and confirmed down were not independently asserted and generic immutability might imply protection from local root.
documented_resolution: Separate sample clocks and freshness. Verify filtering before export, correlate security and operations events, and distinguish application append-only privileges from evidence storage outside host trust.
verification: Advance fixture clock across freshness boundary, then submit known unhealthy sample. Expected state changes healthy to unknown to degraded.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Separate sample clocks and freshness. Verify filtering before export, correlate security and operations events, and distinguish application append-only privileges from evidence storage outside host trust.

problem: A lost lease could permit the old worker's effects after successor starts; queue retry totals, DST and notification ambiguity lacked proof.
documented_resolution: Use fence at the effect boundary and terminal compare-and-set at the store. Separate cancellation request from canceled. Retry only observed safe intent or provider-supported deduplication.
verification: Expire lease while old worker is paused before dispatch; restore old worker after successor applies, then inspect effect generation.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Use fence at the effect boundary and terminal compare-and-set at the store. Separate cancellation request from canceled. Retry only observed safe intent or provider-supported deduplication.

problem: Logical aliases and historic proposed route catalogs were not distinct; request/response schemas and security tuples lacked closure.
documented_resolution: Treat source routes as candidates and separately resolve prefix, placeholder names, errors and payload schemas. Replay lookups require actor and current visibility before return. Browser CSRF, callbacks and scoped key semantics require separate tests.
verification: Replay a valid mutation then repeat after revocation and with a changed payload; verify no identifier leak or extra effect.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Treat source routes as candidates and separately resolve prefix, placeholder names, errors and payload schemas. Replay lookups require actor and current visibility before return. Browser CSRF, callbacks and scoped key semantics require separate tests.

problem: Gates lacked enforced exact candidate binding, applicability accounting and restore/recovery evidence requirements.
documented_resolution: Use fail-closed certification with one applicable evidence verdict per committed case and exact commit, artifact, environment and provenance. Unknown/unset guard always blocks affected stage.
verification: Evaluate missing evidence, mismatched signature or digest, inherited expired approval and open Critical/High blocker as separate fixtures.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Use fail-closed certification with one applicable evidence verdict per committed case and exact commit, artifact, environment and provenance. Unknown/unset guard always blocks affected stage.

problem: Future protected operations needed exact authority binding, secret custody, and rules for post-approval drift.
documented_resolution: Use a human-owned task scope and a separate release approver; explicit authorization applies to protected merge, credentials, destructive changes and production. Documentation work continues independently.
verification: Evaluate task against wrong repo, host, branch, environment, privilege, expired window and changed digest separately; every result is blocked with no protected side effect.
status: Documentation corrected or bounded; engineering verification pending
v3_basis: Use a human-owned task scope and a separate release approver; explicit authorization applies to protected merge, credentials, destructive changes and production. Documentation work continues independently.
